    Proposition 2.6(3), assembled #

    The realization of the path category on radical layers descends to linear isomorphisms φ_d : C_d(x, y) ≃ J^d/J^{d+1} from the path-degree parts of k(Γ_A) = C(Γ_A, c) (GradedRealization.lean: well-definedness from the mesh relations, surjectivity, injectivity). They send arrows to the chosen basis vectors and are compatible with composition. The Hom spaces of k(Γ_A) are the internal direct sums of their degree parts, because the mesh ideal is generated by homogeneous relations.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
